embeds.title: Sunnypilot Model Retention Questionnaire [General/Model Discussions] model_drop
embeds.description:
Good day everyone! 
With support for over 96 driving models in sunnypilot, the time has come to begin discriminating models the userbase does not use. If you like a model and want to keep driving it, check the box on the form below to ensure it stays!
